firewall.text: Our proposal covers 40 rooms with hotel-grade blackout drapery, installed by December.
Total contract price: PHP 952,560, inclusive of installation and an 8% contingency.
We source the fabric from Lucky Textiles in Divisoria at PHP 310 per metre.
Our markup on this job is 35% over the supplier invoice.
Please deposit the downpayment to BDO account 0012-3456-7890, GSSC Integrated Corp.
Lead time is five to seven weeks from signed purchase order.
The warranty covers defects in workmanship for 12 months.
Cost basis per window is PHP 6,200; we sell at PHP 11,650.
Contact Mr. Tan at Sunrise Fabrics (0917 555 1234) for the swatches.
Payment terms: 50% on signing, 50% on completion.
